HEIC decoding: heic-to 1.6.6 (LGPL-3.0), distributed without modifications.
Source and corresponding decoder sources: https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to/tree/v1.6.6

libheif: https://github.com/strukturag/libheif (LGPL-3.0).
The application dynamically imports the separate HEIC module when required.
